narr: Scattered thunderstorms associated with low pressure and a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of southeast Virginia.
ev: Numerous roads were flooded in the Denbigh area to Fort Eustis. A few vehicles were stranded in high water near Denbigh Boulevard.
lsr: NUMEROUS ROADS FLOODED IN THE DENBIGH AREA TO FT. EUSTIS. A FEW VEHICLES WERE STRANDED IN HIGH WATER NEAR DENBIGH BLVD.
